decisions.reason: Approval of the landing page's current top half does not necessarily change its responsive behavior or breakpoint guidance; item 3 is a separate acceptance already represented in this Requirement.
Approval of the top-half visual design does not establish a new token value or alter the existing font and button-color preferences.
Proceeding with the approved top half does not necessarily change the implementation stack, Astro decision, or handoff objective.
The shared header, footer, and dark-theme treatment is accepted separately through item 2; it is not a necessary consequence of approving the landing page's top half.
The footer's page coverage and theme are established by the separate item 2 acceptance, not by approval of the landing page's top half.
The console shell styling deliverable is addressed independently in item 4 and is unaffected by approval of the landing page's top half.
